title: Ice Prison
body:
Syntax: perform ice prison <target>

Description: Encase one enemy in ice; a successful hit may briefly stop their actions.  Requires Ice Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 203-235. 45% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 42 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 14 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
